nexuspay.js
import Nexus from '@nexuspay/sdk';
// Initialize with API Key
const nexus = new Nexus('nx_live_...2k9');
// Create a checkout session
const session = await nexus.checkout.create({
amount: 50000, // ₹500.00
currency: 'INR',
customer: { email: 'dev@nexuspay.in' },
callback_url: 'https://your-site.com/success'
});
// Redirect to payment page
nexus.checkout.redirect(session.id);
